<!-- ==========================================================================
  This page is NOT in the site navigation yet. To turn it on, uncomment the
  Video line in _quarto.yml.

  To add a video, copy one of the blocks below and change the three lines.
  Quarto's video shortcode handles YouTube, Vimeo, and local files.

  WHERE TO PUT THE FILE
  ---------------------
  Under about 20 MB: drop it in assets/video/ and reference it by path.
  Anything larger: upload it to YouTube or Vimeo as unlisted and paste the URL
  instead. GitHub refuses single files over 100 MB, and a repo full of video
  makes every clone and every site build slow.
=========================================================================== -->
